tools.name: get_datetime
tools.description: Get the current date, time, day of the week and time zone on this phone.

tools.name: calculate
tools.description: Evaluate an arithmetic expression exactly. Supports + - * / ^ %, parentheses and decimals.

tools.name: get_battery_status
tools.description: Get the phone's battery level, whether it is charging, and battery temperature.

tools.name: get_device_info
tools.description: Get the phone's manufacturer, model, Android version, processor and total memory.

tools.name: get_storage_status
tools.description: Get the phone's total, used and free storage space.

tools.name: get_network_status
tools.description: Get whether the phone is online and whether it uses Wi-Fi or mobile data.
